phrases.latin: In cubiculō, quod balneō pluviō īnstrūctum erat, duo lectī et fenestra ūna erant.
phrases.english: In the room, which had a shower, there were two beds and one window.

phrases.latin: In cubiculō suō pater puerum, balneolō pluviō breviter lautum et linteō siccātum, veste nocturnā induit
phrases.english: In their room Dad gave the boy a quick shower, dried him with a towel and put his pyjamas on
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
